title: x-setup
description: Declares which setup recipe must run before a scenario workflow to provision required test fixtures. The recipe's outputs become available via the $setup.outputs.X expression root. Optional on scenario workflows, forbidden on recipes. See Arazzo Handbook §4.7.

recipe.description: File stem of the recipe (e.g., 'basic-two-customers-one-order' resolves to 'basic-two-customers-one-order.recipe.yaml')

inputs.description: Values passed to the recipe's workflow inputs. Supports date tokens (@today+3d, @now-1h, etc.) in values.
